02 / LIMITATIONS FIRST

A view is not a verdict.

Appearance fitting cannot establish unseen geometry, event order, or real-world distances.

Media inventoryBROWSER LOCAL

Start with the source.

Choose photos or videos to calculate SHA-256 hashes in this browser. Files stay on your device unless you explicitly submit them to the local reconstruction service.

Select 4–200 photos or a video

Local reconstruction estimates camera poses with COLMAP, then fits RGB on fixed isotropic Gaussians. More overlap and texture improve the chance of a usable result.

Processing boundaries
  • Original source bytes remain unchanged.
  • Selected derivatives receive new hashes.
  • Blur and duplicate decisions are recorded.
  • Failed registration is a reported failure.
  • No remote GPU or API key required.
The hosted demo cannot run COLMAP. Use the repository’s local service to reconstruct uploaded media, then import its scene JSON here.

What the score means

PSNR measures image agreement. It does not establish metric accuracy, source authenticity, event sequence, or evidentiary reliability.
